title: Homeward Website Photo Guide
intro: Use high-resolution JPG or WebP images. The site uses object-fit cropping, so the most important rule is to keep faces and key subjects away from the extreme edges. You usually need one flexible image; only the large Circles and Practices hero images have an optional separate mobile crop.
general: Export JPG or WebP at 80–90% quality. Aim for roughly 300–700 KB when practical; avoid multi-megabyte originals.
Keep faces and important details inside the center 60–70% of the frame so responsive cropping has room to work.
Do not place text inside photographs. Website text should remain HTML for accessibility and mobile scaling.
Landscape and square photos are usually safer than very narrow portrait images unless the CMS specifically calls for a portrait crop.
homepage: Homepage hero: 1600×1200 px or larger (4:3 works well). Keep the group or main subject centered; one flexible crop is normally sufficient.
Homepage practice/collage images: 1200×900 to 1200×1200 px. Keep subjects centered because the tiles crop responsively.
Homepage founder photo: about 1400×1200 px. A slightly landscape or near-square composition works best.
circles: Circles hero desktop: 1600×1600 px or larger, near-square with generous breathing room. The desktop panel is tall and crops with object-fit: cover.
Circles hero mobile (optional): 1600×1200 px, 4:3 landscape. Use this only when the desktop crop loses a face or important subject on phones.
Why-practice photo: 1600×1200 px, 4:3. One crop works on desktop and mobile.
practices: Practices hero desktop: 1600×1600 px or larger, near-square with the person or focal point near center.
Practices hero mobile (optional): 1600×1200 px, 4:3 landscape. Leave blank if the desktop image already crops well on phones.
Practice Library card photos: 1600×1080 px, roughly 3:2. Keep the focal point centered vertically.
story: Our Story hero mosaic photos: 1200×900 px or larger, roughly 4:3. The mosaic crops each image differently, so keep faces near center.
Journey photo carousel: 1400×1000 px or larger, 4:3-ish. One photo can be marked as contain when preserving the full original is more important than filling the frame.
Founder/trust portrait: 1200×1350 px or larger, near 8:9 portrait. Keep head and shoulders centered; on tablets/phones the same image becomes a wider crop.
